Screen Crawl
fields.description: Route 4: a browser logs in and reads the rendered screens as they stand — text, placeholders, tooltips and Select options; nothing is clicked. Runs only where Playwright is installed (not on Frappe Cloud). The password is stored encrypted and never written to logs or exports.

fields.label: Site URL to Crawl
fields.description: Leave empty to crawl this site.

fields.label: Crawl User
fields.description: A read-only user is recommended. Administrator is used when empty. The user needs read permission on the DocTypes of every target app: a screen it may not open is counted as not opened, not measured (324 of 400 with one read-only user). Any System Manager can read a stored password back, so give this user a password used for nothing else.

fields.label: Max Screens per Scan
fields.description: 0 = no limit. A site with 650 DocTypes has about 2,000 screens, at three seconds each.
